reviews.comment:
Volvíamos de los Antiguos Santa Cruz.
Y paramos a cargar  gasoil. Muy buena atención del playero solo que cuando quisimos usar el baño  no pudimos porque lo estaban limpiando  la empleada nos dijo que iba a demorarse. El otro baño contiguo estaba cerrado por reformas y solo se podía usar el baño de adentro si eras socio!
No entiendo esa diferencia que hacen!
Creo que todos nos merecemos ser tenidos en cuenta seamos socios o no!’

(Translated by Google)
We were returning from the old Santa Cruz gas station.

We stopped to fill up with diesel. The attendant was very helpful, but when we wanted to use the restroom, we couldn't because it was being cleaned. The employee told us it would take a while. The other restroom next door was closed for renovations, and only members could use the restroom inside!
I don't understand this difference they make!
I think everyone deserves to be treated with respect, whether they're members or not!
